name: browser-mcp
description: Expose Chrome/Edge as MCP tools — the extension serves MCP directly through code-mcp-gateway (no local server needed).

scripts.check: bun build browser-mcp.ts --no-bundle > /dev/null && bun build scripts/build-extension.ts --no-bundle > /dev/null && for f in packages/browser-extension/src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.icons: cd packages/browser-extension/icons && for s in 16 48 128; do rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s -o app-icon-$s.png mcp-gray.svg; rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s -o connected-$s.png mcp-green.svg; done
